title: POTV XMAX V3 Pro Vaporizer
description:
Who’s the V3 Pro for?

The POTV XMAX V3 Pro vaporizer is for anyone in the market for a strong, budget-friendly convection vaporizer that’s easy to use and offers a wide assortment of accessories. You’ll feel right at home with its multiple vaping modes and potent clouds, and irresistible features like replaceable batteries, precise temperature control, and haptic feedback.

$45 worth of upgrades – POTV exclusive

We’ve teamed up with XMAX to bring you our own POTV-branded V3 Pro packed with $45 worth of upgrades and accessories, all at the same price. Available only at Planet of the Vapes.

Add glass with our Accessory Attachment

We’ve designed a magnetic Accessory Attachment specifically for the V3 Pro, complete with a built-in stir tool! Enjoy even cooler vapor with our line of glass attachments and accessories.

Cooler vapor with our Dimpled Glass Stem

Experience cooler vapor from your V3 Pro with our included Dimpled Glass Stem mouthpiece. It produces flavorful, comfortable vapor that you feel with each draw.

Dimpled Stem Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild dishwashing detergent. Isopropyl alcohol will work as well.

40% more battery life

We made huge improvements so you can spend more time vaping and less time charging, with 40% more battery life than the original version.

Dosing capsule included

Dosing capsules are easier to load and keep your vape cleaner, so we included one in every POTV XMAX V3 Pro.

The ultimate cleaning brush

We went through 3 rounds of prototypes to get this just the way we want it. Tidy up and keep your vaporizer in top condition with our ultimate, redesigned cleaning brush.

Tasty, convection vapor

The V3 Pro produces satisfying convection vapor that is strong and effective, yet flavorful at the same time. Enjoy the natural flavors and potency of your favorite herbs with an isolated airpath, comfortable airflow, and minimal harshness.

Heats up in under 30 seconds

Whether you’re in session mode or on-demand mode, tasty vapor is only 15 to 25 seconds away.

Replaceable batteries with USB-C Charging

Not only is the battery life fantastic, but the V3 Pro also takes it even higher with a swappable 18650 3500 mAh battery and USB-C charging. Quickly swap out batteries to keep the session rolling on.

Two vaping modes

On-demand

In On-demand mode, the V3 Pro will only heat up to temperature as you press and hold the power button. Take a hit, set it down, and come back to it later with zero waste in between.

Session mode

In Session mode, the V3 Pro heats up and holds the temperature with a single click. Enjoy multiple hits over the course of a four or six minute session.

Add a touch of personal style

We’ve got you covered with two new color options for the POTV XMAX V3 Pro’s glass attachment options.

Blue: Bring a sense of calmness and captivation to your vaping sessions. Its soothing shade creates a serene ambiance, allowing you to unwind and relax while enjoying your favorite herbs.

Green: A refreshing connection to the natural world. The essence of fresh foliage, transporting you to a serene forest where you can recharge and rejuvenate during your vaping sessions.

Easy to use

With features like precise temperature control and haptic feedback, the V3 Pro is a walk in the park. Turn it on / off with a single power button, set an exact temperature with up and down buttons, and check the battery level and current temperature on its full OLED screen.

Five unique colors

Black: A classic, matte Black finish.

Purple: A soft, violet finish for a touch of personality.

Silver Gradient: A classic Silver finish that fades down into a unique Blue tint.

Green: A cool emerald green that’s rich in character.

Blue: As calming and serene as a summer sky.

Pick up more dosing capsules

Dosing capsules are a game changer, so be sure to pick up the XMAX V3 Pro Dosing Capsules bundle.

Built to last

The POTV XMAX V3 Pro is constructed with a sturdy aluminum alloy shell and reliable internal components. You’ll have nothing to worry about if it takes a small tumble or a few bumps.

Cleaning Disclaimer: Rubbing alcohol will damage any silicone on the device. Clean silicone with warm water and mild dish detergent ONLY.

Read our in-depth review of the V3 Pro

The XMAX V3 Pro dry herb vaporizer delivers – it’s small, punchy, and affordable with great battery life! Whether you want a high performance vape, or a budget option, you just might find both here.

User manual

POTV XMAX V3 Pro User Manual

Warranty

The POTV XMAX V3 Pro comes with a one-year warranty. You will need your device’s serial number to be eligible for warranty work, which can be located on a sticker on the bottom of the box. As one of the leading retailers of dry herb vapes, vaporizers sold at Planet of the Vapes are also covered by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.
